name: Sparkpost
description: Integrates Drupal with the SparkPost transactional mail service.
project_description:
The Sparkpost module provides integration with Sparkpost transactional email. SparkPost is the email delivery service based on the Momentum platform. It provides the same deliverability, scalability and speed as we provide to the biggest senders in the world, in an easily integrated cloud solution.

 Requirements: 
 
 PHP 5.5+ 
 Composer 
 Drush 
 
 Module dependencies: 
 
 mailsystem (>=2.x) 
 composer_manager 
 
 Composer dependencies: 
 
 sparkpost/php-sparkpost:^1.0.3 
 guzzlehttp/guzzle:~6.0 
 
 Read about managing composer dependencies in Drupal 7 with composer manager .

 Credits 
 This module was inspired by Mandrill .
